note: Seward County's official zoning districts are published only as a static PDF map (Zoning-Map.pdf, adopted 2007) and regulations PDF. The county GIS page lists no zoning layer and no public ArcGIS REST zoning service was found. City of Seward zoning is kept as a map by the city clerk, with no queryable service found for the city. Only third-party viewers (zoneomics) and vendor parcel data (Regrid) carry district codes.
